{{Short description|Cohort succeeding Generation Alpha}}
{{pp|small=yes}}
{{Generations_sidebar}}
'''Generation Beta''', often shortened to '''Gen Beta''', is the proposed name for the demographic [[Cohort (statistics)|cohort]] succeeding [[Generation Alpha]]. The name was coined by [[futurist]] and [[Demography|demographer]] Mark McCrindle, who also coined the name ''Generation Alpha''. He defines the cohort as those born from 2025 to 2039,<ref name="mccrindle" /> with this definition having been reported by numerous sources citing McCrindle.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Najib |first=Shafiq |date=December 31, 2024 |title=Gen Beta kicks off in 2025: Your guide to all the generation names and years |url=https://abcnews.go.com/GMA/Living/generation-names-and-years/story?id=114802892 |access-date=2025-01-01 |website=ABC News}}</ref><ref name=":23">{{Cite web |last=Venkatraman |first=Sakshi |date=2024-12-27 |title=Move over, Gen Alpha: 2025 marks the start of the Gen Beta era |url=https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/generation-beta-starting-2025-ai-tech-like-never-before-rcna184732 |access-date=2025-01-01 |website=NBC News}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Cross |first=Greta |date=December 31, 2024 |title=Welcome Gen Beta: A new generation of humanity starts in 2025 |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2024/12/31/generation-beta-2025-years/77363820007/ |access-date=2025-01-01 |website=USA Today}}</ref><ref name="Independent">{{Cite web |last=Hebert |first=Olivia |date=December 28, 2024 |title=2025 officially marks the transition from Gen Alpha to Gen Beta |url=https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/gen-beta-gen-alpha-2025-transition-years-when-b2670860.html |access-date=2025-01-01 |website=The Independent |language=en-GB}}</ref>

McCrindle expects the generation's members to be primarily the children of [[Zillennials|younger Millennials]] and [[Generation Z]].<ref name="mccrindle">{{Cite web |date=2024-12-19 |title=Welcome Gen Beta - McCrindle |url=https://mccrindle.com.au/article/generation-beta-defined/ |access-date=2025-02-27 |website=mccrindle.com.au |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Terminology ==
The proposed term "Generation Beta" comes from the Greek letter [[beta]], to follow Generation Alpha, named for the Greek letter [[alpha]]. Since the term "[[Alpha and beta male|Beta]]" is sometimes used as an insult meaning someone who is weak or passive, some have suggested that a different name may prevail for the generation.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-03-06 |title=Is Gen Beta’s name actually an insult? Why some believe generation’s label is ‘cringe’ |url=https://www.yahoo.com/lifestyle/gen-beta-name-actually-insult-143633815.html |access-date=2025-04-18 |website=Yahoo Life |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Alcántara |first=Ann-Marie |title=A New Generation Is Here. Its Name Is Already an Insult. |url=https://www.wsj.com/lifestyle/a-new-generation-is-here-its-name-is-already-an-insult-23e18a2e |access-date=2025-08-29 |website=The Wall Street Journal |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Date range definitions ==

Since no official body determines generational boundaries, the starting year of this generation may be subject to future revision. [[Generation#Social generation|Social generations]] typically span approximately 15 years and are shaped by major societal shifts.<ref name="Dimmock-2019b">{{cite web |last=Dimmock |first=Michael |date=January 17, 2019 |title=Defining generations: Where Millennials end and post-Millennials begin |url=http://www.pewresearch.org/fact-tank/2018/03/01/defining-generations-where-millennials-end-and-post-millennials-begin/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190117042517/http://www.pewresearch.org/fact-tank/2018/03/01/defining-generations-where-millennials-end-and-post-millennials-begin/ |archive-date=January 17, 2019 |access-date=December 21, 2019 |publisher=Pew Research Center}}</ref>

Mark McCrindle, who coined the term ''Generation Beta'', uses 2025 as the starting birth year and 2039 as the ending birth year,<ref name="mccrindle" /> following Generation Alpha for which McCrindle uses a date range of 2010–2024.

However, deciding on a date range for Generation Beta is made difficult due to there being general disagreement over the ending year for the preceding Generation Alpha. Some sources have followed McCrindle's definition of the generations, putting the end year for Generation Alpha at 2024,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Marketing to Generation Alpha, the Newest and Youngest == Speculations ==
=== Demographics ===
Generation Beta will be impacted by [[Sub-replacement fertility|declining birth rates]], and, according to McCrindle, will likely make up around 16% of the world's population in 2035.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Najib |first=Shafiq |title=Generation Beta starts in 2025: 5 things to know |url=https://abcnews.go.com/GMA/Living/generation-beta-starts-2025-5-things/story?id=117256891 |access-date=2025-04-17 |website=ABC News |language=en}}</ref> McCrindle predicts Generation Beta to reach 2.1 billion people, surpassing Generation Alpha's 2 billion.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Rubin |first=April |date=2025-01-01 |title=Meet Gen Beta, starting to be born in 2025 |url=https://www.axios.com/2025/01/01/generation-beta-born-2025-2039 |access-date=2025-04-18 |website=Axios |language=en}}</ref> McCrindle has suggested that Generation Beta will have a stronger appreciation for diversity than previous generations.<ref name=":0" /> It is expected that many members of Generation Beta will live to see the [[3rd millennium#22nd century|22nd century]]<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |date=2024-12-27 |title=Move over, Gen Alpha: 2025 marks the start of the Gen Beta era |url=https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/generation-beta-starting-2025-ai-tech-like-never-before-rcna184732 |access-date=2025-08-02 |website=NBC News |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Cross |first=Greta |title=Welcome Gen Beta: A new generation of humanity starts in 2025 |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2024/12/31/generation-beta-2025-years/77363820007/ |access-date=2025-08-03 |website=USA TODAY |language=en-US}}</ref> with many members still in their working age as young as 62.

Generation Beta is expected to be one of the most [[Urbanization|urbanized]] generations in history with the [[World Economic Forum]] projecting that in 2040 that around 58% of the generation will live in cities. A rate higher than Gen Alpha's projected 53% and Gen Z's projected 45% at similar ages, it also projected that members of Gen Beta who grow up in [[Developing country|developing countries]] will make a larger share of global spending compared to members in [[Developed country|developed countries]] compared to previous generations. It also projects the population of Gen Beta to be overall smaller compared to other generations and will feature more people being born in [[Sub-Saharan Africa]], compared to [[Asia-Pacific]] regions and regions in the rest of the world compared to previous generations.<ref>{{Cite web |title=How Gen Beta will fit into and redefine tomorrow's world |url=https://www.weforum.org/stories/2025/02/generation-beta-and-the-global-economy/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250925143452/https://www.weforum.org/stories/2025/02/generation-beta-and-the-global-economy/ |archive-date=2025-09-25 |access-date=2026-01-12 |website=World Economic Forum |language=en}}</ref>

=== Technology ===
According to McCrindle, members of Generation Beta will likely not only adapt to technologies but will immerse themselves in them from the outset more than any previous generation.<ref name=":22">{{Cite web |last=Venkatraman |first=Sakshi |date=2024-12-27 |title=Move over, Gen Alpha: 2025 marks the start of the Gen Beta era |url=https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/generation-beta-starting-2025-ai-tech-like-never-before-rcna184732 |access-date=2025-01-01 |website=NBC News}}</ref> Due to the large amount of technology that Generation Beta will grow up in, McCrindle suggests that Generation Z parents may prefer to shield their children from constant internet exposure.<ref name=":22" /> McCrindle has also said that Generation Beta will be characterised by significant technological integration, and experts have predicted that Generation Beta children will grow up immersed and integrated with [[artificial intelligence]] (AI).<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":2" /> Some researchers theorize this integration will extend beyond functional use into the psychological realm, leading the cohort to develop what have been termed "fluid identity boundaries" with AI systems, forming deep emotional and intellectual attachments to them.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://pinnacledemographics.org/article/generation-gpt-defining-new-demographics |title=The Generational Shift: Defining Generation GPT |website=Pinnacle Demographics |access-date=2025-08-27}}</ref>

According to experts, misinformation and disinformation are likely to grow during Generation Beta's time due to growing political polarization and growing indistinguishability between real and [[AI-generated material]].<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-06-26 |title=Wreck the Vote: How AI-Driven Misinformation Could Undermine Democracy |url=https://www.gsb.stanford.edu/insights/wreck-vote-how-ai-driven-misinformation-could-undermine-democracy |access-date=2025-04-18 |website=Stanford Graduate School of Business |language=en}}</ref> Attention spans are also expected to continue decreasing in Generation Beta children.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Moulton |first=Cyrus |date= |title=Squirrel! Why attention spans seem to be shrinking and what we can do about it |url=https://news.northeastern.edu/2024/01/23/decreasing-attention-span/ |access-date=2025-04-19 |website=Northeastern Global News |language=en-US}}</ref>

Lance Eliot from ''[[Forbes]]'' refers to Generation Beta as "AI naturals", claiming that, "[a]s youngsters, AI will merely naturally be integral to their upbringing. [...] No need to get excited about the fact that AI is always there and at the ready."<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |last=Eliot |first=Lance |title=Generation Beta Gets Underway As Beta Babies Arrive 2025 – 2039 Growing Up Amid AI, AGI, And Artificial Superintelligence |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/lanceeliot/2025/01/05/generation-beta-gets-underway-as-beta-babies-arrive-2025--2039-growing-up-amid-ai-agi-and-artificial-superintelligence/ |access-date=2025-08-29 |website=Forbes |language=en}}</ref> He expects that Generation Beta "will be growing up during the anticipated [[AI boom|rapid advancement of AI]], including potentially the attainment of [[artificial general intelligence]] (AGI)".<ref name=":3" />

=== Global issues ===
McCrindle has predicted that, due to having parents that care more about global issues, including [[climate change]], Generation Beta will be more focused on these issues.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":22" />
